objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level (e.g. code of conduct, travel expenses policy, ICS policy, process and organizational structure)

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Standardized abbreviation for document type

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or title of the policy

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: User responsible for creating the policy

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional users with write permissions on the policy

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: User responsible for checking content

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User responsible for approving and releasing the policy

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group with view permissions

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related documents or master data

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Associated IT systems or applications

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Company or organizational unit for which policy applies

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of applicability

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when policy becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when policy expires

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period before validity check is required

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the policy

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the policy

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons to notify by email on release

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to confirm receipt

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled documents that are automatically released with the release of the main document and are subject to own versioning

attributes.description: Name or title of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.description: Date when attachment becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when attachment expires

attributes.description: Name or title of the additional information

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Publication status

attributes.name: content

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Purpose or function of the IT system

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of master data

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Specific master data value

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type to initiate document creation

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the editing client based on the existing source format

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Modification of document metadata and attributes including standardized and customer-specific metadata

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: Selection of a predefined document template when creating new document objects

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system-supported conversion of edited document to PDF format

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature of document by workflow participants (Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the review step in the document release workflow by the author or co-author

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Checking of document content according to technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewers

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and distribution of a document by assigned releasers to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a document to readers after successful release

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new editing version when changes are made to a released document or its attributes

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to a new version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a proposal to amend an existing document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a new document version when a change proposal is scheduled for implementation

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic system creation of a validity extension request when document reaches 30 days before expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extension of document validity period by releaser or by author/reviewer/releaser after processing validity extension request

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of a new version of a released document with retention and adaptation of previous version data

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Manual creation of a request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of a document as invalid and archiving of the document and its attachments

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document during archiving period

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of an invalidated document with restoration of metadata, properties, and attachments

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document attachment to a main document

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Addition of supplementary information attachment to a document without subject to release cycle

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change rights to users and user groups for document access control

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Configuration of automatic email notification to user groups or persons upon document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Configuration of workflow-supported acknowledgement confirmation requirement for document recipients

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation of document acknowledgement by recipients as requested in distribution

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language with workflow-supported approval

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Reading and viewing of approved documents by authorized readers

evts.name: search_documents
evts.description: Execution of role-specific evaluation reports and searches with selection parameters and criteria

evts.name: generate_status_report
evts.description: Creation of evaluation reports showing document status with traffic light system based on validity dates

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload of external files or documents to a document object cover

o2o.description: Policies provide company-wide strategic framework to which guidelines document locally defined regulations
Guidelines define roles, objectives and framework for which procedural instructions describe specific procedures
Work instructions describe detailed work steps that go beyond the scope of procedural instruction
Attachments are controlled documents automatically released with policy
Attachments are controlled documents automatically released with guideline
Attachments are controlled documents automatically released with procedural instruction
Attachments are controlled documents automatically released with work instruction
Additional information can be added to policy as supplementary materials
Additional information can be added to guideline as supplementary materials
Additional information can be added to procedural instruction as supplementary materials
Additional information can be added to work instruction as supplementary materials
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in policy documents
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in guideline documents
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in procedural instruction documents
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in work instruction documents
Validity extension request is linked to policy document being checked
Validity extension request is linked to guideline document being checked
Validity extension request is linked to procedural instruction document being checked
Validity extension request is linked to work instruction document being checked
Override request is created for policy document to be invalidated
Override request is created for guideline document to be invalidated
Override request is created for procedural instruction document to be invalidated
Override request is created for work instruction document to be invalidated
Reactivation request is created to reactivate invalidated policy document
Reactivation request is created to reactivate invalidated guideline document
Reactivation request is created to reactivate invalidated procedural instruction document
Reactivation request is created to reactivate invalidated work instruction document
Template is selected when creating new policy document
Template is selected when creating new guideline document
Template is selected when creating new procedural instruction document
Template is selected when creating new work instruction document
Policy can be linked to and reference business processes
Guideline can be linked to and reference business processes
Procedural instruction can be linked to and reference business processes
Work instruction can be linked to and reference business processes
Policy can reference identified business risks
Guideline can reference identified business risks
Procedural instruction can reference identified business risks
Work instruction can reference identified business risks
Policy can reference associated IT systems or applications
Guideline can reference associated IT systems or applications
Procedural instruction can reference associated IT systems or applications
Work instruction can reference associated IT systems or applications
Policy can be linked to master data for context and classification
Guideline can be linked to master data for context and classification
Procedural instruction can be linked to master data for context and classification
Work instruction can be linked to master data for context and classification
Policy is linked to relevant company or organizational unit for which it applies
Guideline is linked to relevant company or organizational unit for which it applies
Procedural instruction is linked to relevant company or organizational unit for which it applies
Work instruction is linked to relevant company or organizational unit for which it applies
User is a member of a user group with shared authorization levels
User group can have read authorization assigned to policy documents
User group can have read authorization assigned to guideline documents
User group can have read authorization assigned to procedural instruction documents
User group can have read authorization assigned to work instruction documents
